title: Rubycraft
description: This mod adds Ruby's to the game. As well as Ruby Armor, Ruby Blocks, Ruby Tools, new custom enchantments and much more
body:
### What is this mod?
---
This Mod is adding ruby themed stuff in the game, because they fixed the mistake from one of the creators, that the emeralds where red (like ruby's) so i thought i make a mod, that adds ruby's in different colors and variations
<details>
<summary>Included:</summary>

Pink Ruby

Pink Ruby Block

Raw Pink Ruby

Raw Pink Ruby Block

Bloody Ruby Block

Raw Bloody Ruby Block

</details>

---

Please note that this a part of the The Other Ores Mod that will be released in future

---

please Report any Problems, Bugs or Issues with the mod in the #newmc-help channel on my [Discord](https://discord.gg/invite/QT7SwbMU4k)
